title: Modifying a copy
hints: The scores never change. In for _, s := range students, s is a copy of each Student, so updating s.Score changes only the copy.
Write to the element in the slice instead, through its index: students[i].Score. A pointer, p := &students[i], works too.
for i := range students { students[i].Score = min(students[i].Score+bonus, 100) }
